hindsight_boundary.historical_data_role: Causal lookback warmup only; no return whose execution date is on or before 2026-08-28 may be scored.
hindsight_boundary.real_data_runner_activation_requirement: A separate runtime and future input-source binding must be independently published before the first eligible signal close.

primary_specification.signal_information_set: adjusted SPY and BIL closes observed through session close t only
primary_specification.extension_rule: Use the latest 40 fully observed SPY close returns if and only if fewer than 3 of the latest 20 returns satisfy r_i < 0.
primary_specification.n_definition: n is the selected window length: 20 normally or 40 after the sparse-negative extension; n is not the negative-return count.
primary_specification.fallback_rule: Only when the selected 40-session downside-semivolatility value is zero or nonfinite, use the incumbent annualized total-volatility estimate over the latest 20 returns.
primary_specification.fallback_formula: sqrt(252) * sqrt(sum((r_i - mean(r))^2) / 19) over the latest 20 returns
primary_specification.trend_definition: For each horizon h, log(SPY_close_t / SPY_close_t_minus_h) - log(BIL_close_t / BIL_close_t_minus_h).
primary_specification.volatility_scale: min(1, 0.10 / selected_annualized_volatility) when finite and positive; otherwise 0

prospective_comparison_design.signal_to_execution: Signal at adjusted close t; execute fractional target weights at the next session open t+1.
prospective_comparison_design.holding_and_drift: Hold self-financing drifted SPY/BIL weights between scheduled rebalances; do not reset a held book to its last target.
prospective_comparison_design.expected_signal_session_sequence_rule: The first signal must be 2026-08-31; thereafter signal session N must equal expected execution session N-1.

primary_inference.sole_input: The exact validated primary-cell emitted paired ledgers; no unrounded internal value or alternate reconstruction is eligible.
primary_inference.endpoint: mean paired daily net log-return difference
primary_inference.equivalent_descriptive_identity: sum of paired daily net log-return differences equals the challenger-minus-incumbent cumulative log-wealth difference and is not a second endpoint
primary_inference.null_hypothesis: mean paired daily net log-return difference <= 0
primary_inference.alternative_hypothesis: mean paired daily net log-return difference > 0
primary_inference.test: one-sided null-centered stationary circular block bootstrap
primary_inference.bootstrap_engine: Exact Attempt 114 bootstrap engine reused without alteration
primary_inference.rng_consumption_rule: Consume the restart draw after every emitted observation including the last; when restart triggers, consume the new-index draw.
primary_inference.null_centering: Subtract the observed 252-value mean from every paired daily log-return difference before resampling.
primary_inference.bootstrap_statistic: mean of each 252-value resampled null-centered series
primary_inference.observed_statistic: mean of the original 252 paired daily log-return differences
primary_inference.exceedance_rule: bootstrap mean >= observed mean; equality counts as an exceedance
primary_inference.rejection_rule: Reject only when observed mean > 0 and p_value <= 0.05.
